answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to the temperatures at which food can be accepted upon delivery:

---

## 🌡️ Food Receiving Temperature Guidelines

### ❄️ Cold Foods (TCS – Time/Temperature Control for Safety)
- **General cold TCS foods** (meat, poultry, fish, etc.): Receive cold TCS food at **41°F (5°C) or lower**, unless otherwise specified.

- **Live shellfish** (oysters, mussels, clams, scallops): Receive at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C)** and an internal temperature no greater than **50°F (10°C)**. They should be cooled to **41°F (5°C) or below** within four hours of receiving.

- **Shucked shellfish**: Receive at **45°F (7°C) or lower**.

- **Milk & Shell Eggs**: Milk and eggs can be received at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C) or lower**, but should be refrigerated at or below **41°F (5°C)** upon receiving.

- **Frozen foods**: Frozen food should be **frozen solid** when received. Look for signs of thawing and refreezing, such as ice crystals in the box, fluids or water stains on the case, or frozen liquids on or in the packages.

---

### 🔥 Hot Foods
- Receive hot TCS food at **135°F (57°C) or higher**.

---

### 🚫 When to Reject Food
If food temperatures do not meet requirements, or if TCS food shows evidence of previous temperature abuse, **do not accept the food**, or discard the products.

Other reasons to reject:
- Reject food and non-food items if packaging has tears, holes, or punctures. Likewise, reject cans with labels that are not intact or have bulging or swollen ends, rust, or dents.
- Do not accept food that is missing use-by or expiration dates from the manufacturer.

---

### 🌡️ The Temperature Danger Zone
The danger zone is the temperature range where bacteria thrive: **41°F to 135°F**. Within this range, pathogens like Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria multiply rapidly.

---

### 📋 Quick Reference Summary

| Food Type | Acceptable Receiving Temperature |
|---|---|
| Cold TCS foods (meat, fish, poultry) | 41°F (5°C) or below |
| Live shellfish | 45°F (7°C) air / 50°F (10°C) internal |
| Shucked shellfish | 45°F (7°C) or below |
| Milk & Shell Eggs | 45°F (7°C) or below |
| Frozen foods | Frozen solid (0°F / -18°C or below) |
| Hot TCS foods | 135°F (57°C) or above |

Always use a calibrated thermometer when checking temperatures during receiving to ensure accuracy!
